title: What to Ask a Teen Who Freezes in Group Tasks
description: What to ask a teen who freezes in group work: skip “Why don’t you speak up?” and try one calm question instead. Ask whether joining, speaking, or choosing a task feels hardest. title: A 3-Step Parent Plan for Quiet Teen Group Work
description: A 3-step plan for quiet teen group work: ENTER with “Which part still needs doing?” CONTRIBUTE one visible task or idea. Save this simple plan for class-project week. #ParentingTeens #TeenSkills #GroupProjects #SchoolSupport

title: A Recovery Script for Teens Left Out of Group Work
description: A teen left out of group work does not need a lecture about confidence. Rehearse one recovery line: “I missed the start. What can I take from here?” It gives them a way back into the task after an awkward beginning, without blaming classmates or making them perform. Save this exact script for the next school project. #ParentingTeens #TeenConfidence #GroupWork #ParentScripts
